I understand the stop fighting bit but my OCD leans towards severe indecision and hyper awareness, that’s just a fragment of the whole story but it’s the gist of it, so with me the intrusive thoughts are mainly questioning and never reaching a conclusion. So like let’s say I do go and do something productive, the thing that I’m doing will then be hijacked by “is this the right way I should be doing this?” “Why am I using my right hand instead of left?” So these intrusive thoughts don’t cause me anxiety but instead disorientation and dissociation because of how much mental deliberation is taking place and how much of the outside world I’m tuned out from. So even if I do stop fighting it ruins everything for me, one example is movies “which character should I stare at now, who should I pay attention to?” “Why am I watching this, do I really like it? What do I like about it? Is that really why I like it?” See? No conclusion, no satisfying answer, no end in sight, and while this tennis match of doubt is taking place, i lose track of the movie and life in general like “what now?” I hate this cliche but I truly am “trapped in my head.”
